name: tree_fern
description: Carboniferous tree fern (Psaronius-type): trunk narrow under the crown and widening down into a shaggy skirt of matted roots (root mantle, dark vertical strands), leaf-base scars up top; crown of long feathery fronds that arch up then droop, each a midrib with separate leaflets (front #4f8a3a, back #3a6a2a); three coiled fiddleheads (croziers) rising from the crown centre; a few dead brown fronds hanging under the crown. Not a palm, no forked branches (unlike scale_tree). Anchor = trunk base centre (0,0). x -220..220, y -620..0.
